messages:
Ava: Proposal: introduce a preempt-credit + admission-backoff layer on dedicated GPU autoscaler to reduce noisy evictions for bursty tenants. Short thread to collect ops/telemetry thoughts.

Ravi: Penalty target? Should hit the tenant that caused eviction, not the evicted tenant.

Ava: Agreed. Aggressor penalized. Evicted tenants get a short emergency credit window.

Lin: Sketch: each tenant has 0..100 credits. Preempt consumes credit proportionally. Below threshold => soft admit penalty multiplier. Replenish slowly (e.g. +1 per 6h).

Sam: Need to simulate on real traces first. Also ensure enterprise SLA exemptions require manual entitlement check.

Priya: Ops: store ledger append-only in Postgres (tenant, delta, reason, trace_id). Expose /debug and 7d history for SEs. Add playbook for resets.

Ravi: Telemetry events: penalty_applied, credit_consumed, credit_replenished. Dashboards + alert if one tenant consumes >50 credits/day.

ci-bot: created sim job `sim/preempt-credit-2026-03-02` -> https://ci.redwood/sim/2401 :pipeline_started

Ava: Decision: prototype behind feature flag. Owners: Lin (ledger + admission hook), Ravi (telemetry), Sam (sim). We'll iterate after sim results. Ping me to join canary.
